suc-cēno (subc-, succoe- ), āre, 1, v. a.,
I.to eat below, dine underneath: “Galba de piscibus, qui cum pridie ex parte adesi et versati postero die appositi essent, Festinemus, alii subscenant, inquit,” Quint. 6, 3, 90 Spald. N. cr.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
